_comment: Hand-authored. Bank 6 object handlers: cannons $55-$57 and their fragment helpers ($A349-$A445, $AC9F-$ACE1, $AECF-$AEE7). The generators subtract these.

regions.name: TYPES $55 / $56 / $57 (A CANNON THAT LOBS FRAGMENTS): first frame?
regions.description: TYPES $55 / $56 / $57 (A CANNON THAT LOBS FRAGMENTS): type bit 7 set goes to the per-frame code (`$A373`). Table stats of the three types: collision flags `$50` (Eraser-immune, big burst), drawing flags 0, art block `$26`, dies as type 8; hit points 2 / 4 / 6 (x 16 by `$C165` = 32 / 64 / 96), attack 48 / 64 / 96. **No area scaling.**

regions.name: TYPES $55 / $56 / $57 (A CANNON THAT LOBS FRAGMENTS): palette
regions.description: `$0560` := `$9D9F[type]` (read at `$9DF4`: `03 02 00`, **the same bytes as the palettes of types `$1D`-`$1F`**).

regions.name: TYPES $55 / $56 / $57 (A CANNON THAT LOBS FRAGMENTS): animation step
regions.description: `$07B8` := `$A385[type]` (read at `$A3DA`: `04 18 30`), the step of the phase counter below.

regions.name: TYPES $55 / $56 / $57 (A CANNON THAT LOBS FRAGMENTS): shot mask
TYPES $55 / $56 / $57 (A CANNON THAT LOBS FRAGMENTS): art wait
regions.description: `JSR $C0A8`.

regions.name: TYPES $55 / $56 / $57 (A CANNON THAT LOBS FRAGMENTS): hit points x 16
TYPES $55 / $56 / $57 (A CANNON THAT LOBS FRAGMENTS): picture
regions.description: Metasprite `$69` (the body).

regions.name: TYPES $55 / $56 / $57 (A CANNON THAT LOBS FRAGMENTS): state 0
regions.description: `$07A0` := 0: the first state of the cycle (below).

regions.name: TYPES $55 / $56 / $57 (A CANNON THAT LOBS FRAGMENTS): set-up
regions.description: `JSR $C0A2`.

regions.name: TYPES $55 / $56 / $57 (A CANNON THAT LOBS FRAGMENTS): every frame: the state machine
regions.description: `JSR $A3EA`. It can skip the rest of the handler for this frame (it pops the return address).

regions.name: TYPES $55 / $56 / $57 (A CANNON THAT LOBS FRAGMENTS): flip
regions.description: `LDA #$07 / JSR $9B09`: palette bit 6 flips on every 8th frame.

regions.name: TYPES $55 / $56 / $57 (A CANNON THAT LOBS FRAGMENTS): creep toward the player's y
regions.description: `JSR $A337`: one pixel a frame (every second frame while flickering) toward the player's y. RUN: with the player held at y 140 the cannon settled at y 139.

regions.name: TYPES $55 / $56 / $57 (A CANNON THAT LOBS FRAGMENTS): draw the body
TYPES $55 / $56 / $57 (A CANNON THAT LOBS FRAGMENTS): active?
regions.description: Only state 2 fires; the others go to the picture of the head.

regions.name: TYPES $55 / $56 / $57 (A CANNON THAT LOBS FRAGMENTS): head phase
regions.description: `LDA $07B8 / LDY #$0A / JSR $C0A5`: ten phases; a phase lasts 64 / 10.7 / 5.3 frames for the three types.

regions.name: TYPES $55 / $56 / $57 (A CANNON THAT LOBS FRAGMENTS): firing picture?
regions.description: The head picture `$A3E0[phase]` (`68 68 67 68 68 67 68 67 68 67`); only the picture `$67` fires (phases 2, 5, 7, 9).

regions.name: TYPES $55 / $56 / $57 (A CANNON THAT LOBS FRAGMENTS): which frames
TYPES $55 / $56 / $57 (A CANNON THAT LOBS FRAGMENTS): aim
regions.description: `JSR $C0FF` (`$F863`): the direction to the player, kept in `$15`.

regions.name: TYPES $55 / $56 / $57 (A CANNON THAT LOBS FRAGMENTS): a free slot
regions.description: `JSR $C108`; none: no shot.

regions.name: TYPES $55 / $56 / $57 (A CANNON THAT LOBS FRAGMENTS): make the fragment
regions.description: `JSR $AC9F` (below): a type-`$2A` lobbed fragment, its x speed from the aim.

regions.name: TYPES $55 / $56 / $57 (A CANNON THAT LOBS FRAGMENTS): fragment variant
regions.description: `JSR $ACCA`: palette, art variant, picture.

regions.name: TYPES $55 / $56 / $57 (A CANNON THAT LOBS FRAGMENTS): 24 px up
regions.description: `LDA #$E8 / JSR $AECF`: the fragment's y -= 24 (clamped at 0).

regions.name: TYPES $55 / $56 / $57 (A CANNON THAT LOBS FRAGMENTS): 8 px left
regions.description: The fragment's x -= 8 (`SBC #$08`; the carry left by the clamp routine makes it 8 here: RUN, turret x 163 -> fragment 155).

regions.name: TYPES $55 / $56 / $57 (A CANNON THAT LOBS FRAGMENTS): the timer
regions.description: `JSR $A432`: counts the active time down.

regions.name: TYPES $55 / $56 / $57 (A CANNON THAT LOBS FRAGMENTS): head: flips
TYPES $55 / $56 / $57 (A CANNON THAT LOBS FRAGMENTS): head: draw
regions.description: `$C093` (`$CC34`) draws the head piece `$A3E0[$0638]`.

regions.name: TYPES $55 / $56 / $57 (A CANNON THAT LOBS FRAGMENTS): hit only when active
regions.description: Not state 2: return.

regions.name: TYPES $55 / $56 / $57 (A CANNON THAT LOBS FRAGMENTS): hit test
regions.description: `JSR $C0C6` (mask `$30`).

regions.name: TYPES $55 / $56 / $57 (A CANNON THAT LOBS FRAGMENTS): resolve as a boss would
regions.description: `JMP $C0D8`.

regions.name: Cannon animation step by type
regions.description: `04 18 30` (read from `$A385 + type`).

regions.name: Cannon shot mask by type
regions.description: `0F 03 00` (read from `$A388 + type`).

regions.name: Cannon head picture by phase
Cannon state machine (`$A3EA`): state 0: look for a place
regions.description: `$07A0` = 0: `JSR $C0F3` (a random cell: x 32-223, y 40-183) and `JSR $9A53` (is it free?): blocked returns from the handler and tries again next frame.

regions.name: Cannon state machine (`$A3EA`): state 0 -> 1
regions.description: `$0788` := `$78`, `INC $07A0`. RUN: the cycle is state 1 for 120 frames (appearing: drawn on every second frame only, no fire, no hit), state 2 for 239 (active), state 3 for 60 (disappearing, the same flicker), state 4 for 119 (hidden), then state 0 again and a new place: 539 frames in all, for all three types.

regions.name: Cannon state machine (`$A3EA`): states 1 and 3
regions.description: A count of `$0788` down each frame (`$A408`); at 0 the next state with `$0788` := `$78`.

regions.name: Cannon state machine (`$A3EA`): flicker
regions.description: Odd values of `$0788` return from the handler (not drawn).

regions.name: Cannon state machine (`$A3EA`): next state
Cannon state machine (`$A3EA`): state 2 runs
regions.description: State 2 returns to the handler.

regions.name: Cannon state machine (`$A3EA`): state 4: hidden
regions.description: `$0788` counts down; at 0 the state goes back to 0.

regions.name: Cannon state machine (`$A3EA`): skip this frame
regions.description: `PLA / PLA / RTS`: returns from the handler that called it.

regions.name: Active time (`$A432`)
regions.description: On even `$41` only, `$0788` is decremented; at 0 it becomes `$3C` and the state 3. With `$78` that is 240 frames of fire.

regions.name: Lobbed fragment helpers: make a fragment (`$AC9F`)
regions.description: `LDA #$2A / JSR $C105` makes a type-`$2A` object (the lobbed fragment of the Clawbot's shots) in the slot found.

regions.name: Lobbed fragment helpers: its x speed
regions.description: A random bit (0 or 1) plus `$ACBA[aim direction]` is stored in the new object's `$0788` (the x speed of type `$2A`). A returns with the random byte.

regions.name: Fragment x speed by direction
regions.description: 16 signed bytes `01 01 00 00 FF FF FE FE FE FE FE FF FF 00 00 01` for directions 0-15 (0 right, 8 left): roughly the cosine, -2 to +1.

regions.name: Lobbed fragment helpers: palette
regions.description: `$0560,Y` := the random byte AND 3 (called with A from `$AC9F`).

regions.name: Lobbed fragment helpers: art variant
regions.description: `$0728,Y` and `$07B8,Y` := `$18`. **This is the non-zero `$0728` that gives type `$2A` its own art: it answers the lead 'who sets the second variant of `$2A`'.**

regions.name: Lobbed fragment helpers: picture
regions.description: Metasprite `$37`, `$07A0,Y` := 0.

regions.name: Add a signed byte to a y with clamping (`$AECF`)
regions.description: A signed, Y the slot: `$0518,Y` += A, clamped to 0 / 255.
